subject: Former Liberal candidate cautioned over LGBTQIA+ comments

Evidence: Council remarks, tribunal settlement, professional caution
#Aletheia #Australia

Official council disciplinary mechanisms maintain high standards of public discourse and professional ethics.

An Albany councillor and doctor faced tribunal censure after falsely linking LGBTQIA+ groups to paedophilia during a 2024 debate, concluding a long-running dispute.

Administrative tribunals ultimately curb unevidenced public smears by holding elected officials accountable to professional standards.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (the legal technicality of council codes) with WHO (the human impact of stigmatizing minority communities).

Thomas Brough ran a classic Smart Selfish maneuver, using a lurid wedge pretext to court reactionary factions while projecting victimization when challenged.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic friction rises as political actors deploy slur-adjacent framing.

The Unavoidable Truth: Inflammatory rhetoric against vulnerable groups inflicts lasting civic damage.
The Unavoidable Lie: Disproven slurs are merely innocent questions about semantics.
